propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider, forcing clients through an OpenAI-compatible gateway that loses prompt caching and structured output capabilities
Prompt caching on Bedrock is model-dependent and fails silently; when requested caching produces zero cache read/write tokens while billing full input cost, rebar must warn the operator

Bedrock rejects temperature parameter on some inference profiles with ValidationException 400, hard-failing gate runs, whereas the direct-Anthropic path gracefully degrades; rebar must detect this and surface actionable LLMConfigError naming the model and remedies

Bedrock model capabilities cannot be predicted by profile shape alone and require per-model-id overrides keyed on exact model identifier; a second override table distinct from the profile-shaped one must apply after f184's shipped predicates
The builder must construct BedrockConverseModel with exactly two cache keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, not three
Bedrock must ship as an optional [bedrock] extra so boto3 does not enter the default [agents] install, keeping the runtime dependency-free while allowing unit tests to run in CI
